L1237@P33: REGISTRATION
L1238@P33: General Registration Requirements
L1239@P33: To remain active in their degree program, students must register and pay tuition fees continuously each
L1240@P33: semester. Failing to register and pay tuition fees will result in the loss of student status. The registration
L1241@P33: must be completed via KMUTNB REG System at https://reg.kmutnb.ac.th/registrar/home. The registration
L1242@P33: procedure will be sent via email by registration@tggs.kmutnb.ac.th prior the registration period in each
L1243@P33: semester. The student is responsible for consulting with this procedure and following the instructions.
L1244@P33: Late Registration and Reinstatement
L1245@P33: Students must complete their registration and pay tuition fees by the deadline specified in the Academic
L1246@P33: Calendar. Students who fail to complete their registration during this time will be assessed a late
L1247@P33: registration fee or a reinstatement fee according to the university announcement.
L1248@P33: Late Registration with Late Fee or Study Leave of Absence
L1249@P33: 1. In case that the student cannot register during the Regular Registration Period (as indicated in the
L1250@P33: academic calendar), the student can submit Request for Registration to TGGS Academic Affairs during
L1251@P33: the Late Registration Period but the student is obligated to pay the Late Registration Fee of 200 THB for
L1252@P33: the first week and 400 THB for the second week via KMUTNB REG System https://reg.kmutnb.ac.th and
L1253@P33: pay the tuition fee via KMUTNB REG System according to the student status listed in Tuition Fee Section.
L1254@P33: 2. In case that the student cannot register in person, the student can give the authorization to the friend
L1255@P33: or the family member to act on his/her behave and must notify TGGS Academic Affairs in writing using
L1256@P33: the attached form (KMUTNB 01).
